assessmentBufferPct.sourceTitle: MyState Limited Mortgage Lending Procedure, Broker Version 1.0a, effective 1 July 2026 — s10.2, p51
assessmentBufferPct.note: The procedure applies expressly to 'MyState Bank (MSB) and Auswide Bank (AWB)'. 'The current interest rate servicing buffer for residentially secured consumer loan facilities is 3.00%' — applied to all mortgage-secured debt, internal and external.

assessmentFloorRatePct.sourceTitle: Mortgage Lending Procedure v1.0a — s10.1, p51
assessmentFloorRatePct.note: 'In the assessment of servicing capacity for residentially secured facilities, MSB and AWB adopts a minimum interest rate (The Floor Rate)... The current Floor Rate ... is 6.00%.' Assessed at the higher of the floor rate or the product rate plus the buffer.

rentShadingPct.sourceTitle: Mortgage Lending Procedure v1.0a — s7.5 Rental Income, p37
rentShadingPct.note: Under 'Standard residential property': net rent is 75% of gross rent where property expenses are under 20% of gross, or 95% of gross with actual expenses deducted where they exceed 20%. Medium confidence because of the PDF's two-column layout adjacent to the short-stay heading. Short-stay/Airbnb 65%; commercial 50%.

dtiCap.sourceTitle: Mortgage Lending Procedure v1.0a — Appendix A, LVR Restrictions based on DTI, p73
dtiCap.note: DTI of 8 or above is not accepted for either owner occupied/non-housing or residential investment. Owner occupied bands: below 5 no restriction; 5 to below 7 capped at 80% LVR inclusive of LMI; 7 to below 8 capped at 75%. Investment bands: below 6 no restriction; 6 to below 7 capped at 90%; 7 to below 8 capped at 75%.

dtiReferThreshold.sourceTitle: Mortgage Lending Procedure v1.0a — Appendix A, p73
dtiReferThreshold.note: Point at which LVR restrictions begin for owner-occupied/non-housing lending; DTI 6 for residential investment.

hecsTreatment.value: STSL / HECS / HELP commitments are assessed based on a loan term of 30 years.
hecsTreatment.sourceTitle: Mortgage Lending Procedure v1.0a — s9 Loan Commitments, p45

interestOnlyAssessment.value: Interest-only loans are assessed on a 'residual term' basis — the maximum loan term available for the product less the interest-only term sought — with the applicable buffer/floor rate applied.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Mortgage Lending Procedure v1.0a — Appendix A, Owner Occupied Purchase, p74
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Residential (or rural under 10 ha with residential primary use), P&I: 80% uninsured / 95% + capitalised LMI premium capped at 100% of value. Vacant land 90% + LMI. gaps: MERGER: Auswide Bank and MyState Bank merged on 19 February 2025 (A$755m scheme of arrangement; Auswide became an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of MyState Limited). Both brands still trade and both remain broker-distributed. Since the merger they share ONE broker credit policy — the 'MyState Limited Mortgage Lending Procedure' (Broker Version 1.0a, effective 1 July 2026), which is expressly stated to apply to 'MyState Bank (MSB) and Auswide Bank (AWB)'. This record cites that shared document; see also the mystate-bank record.

KEY BRAND DIFFERENCE FOUND: the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme (Housing Australia) is available via MyState Bank ONLY and is NOT offered by Auswide Bank. Do not route a 5%-deposit-scheme client to Auswide.

Auswide's own broker site (auswidebank.com.au broker section) was not used — the shared MyState broker portal document is the current credit policy. No Auswide-specific credit policy document was found publicly.
Auswide's ABN was not captured from a primary source; the ACL number should be re-verified against an Auswide credit guide.
Minimum and maximum loan amounts are not stated in the shared lending procedure.
Genuine savings requirement is not stated in the shared 2026 procedure (the 5%-above-90%-LVR figure comes only from MyState's legacy 2019 guide and was NOT carried into this record).
Maximum interest-only period is not stated numerically — only the 80% LVR ceiling for IO and the residual-term servicing method.
No credit-card assessment percentage, HEM loading, credit score minimum, arrears tolerance or enquiry limit is published.
Offset / redraw / SMSF / bridging availability for the Auswide product range was not established.
